01 / UNIT OVERVIEW

The unusual is
our everyday.

This community brings the FBI Unusual Incidents Unit to life through fictional roleplay in Emergency Response: Liberty County (ERLC) and Blackhawk Rescue Mission 5 (BRM5). Build your character, work alongside other agents, and help shape stories where every detail could matter.

I / INVESTIGATE

Follow the evidence.

Explore fictional incidents, piece together clues, and develop your character through investigative stories.

II / COORDINATE

Work as a unit.

Bring your perspective to the team. Communication and cooperation give each scene room to grow.

III / CREATE

Build the story.

Make memorable scenes with other members, from the first report to the final case briefing.

OUR GAMES

One unit.
Two operational settings.

We operate in ERLC and BRM5. Our FBI UIU identity connects both games, while each setting offers a different way to build a scene and work as a team.

ERLC

Emergency Response: Liberty County

Bring investigations into Liberty County. Develop character interactions, follow fictional case leads, and coordinate unusual-incident stories within the server's roleplay rules.

INVESTIGATIONS / CHARACTER ROLEPLAY / CASEWORK
BRM5

Blackhawk Rescue Mission 5

Bring the unit into team-based field scenarios. Coordinate in-game movement, aviation support, and mission roleplay while keeping communication and cooperation at the centre of the session.

FIELD TEAMS / AVIATION / COORDINATION

Session plans, game requirements, and department availability are announced in Discord. These are roleplay settings; the community is not affiliated with either game's developers.

03 / SPECIALIST DEPARTMENTS

Different roles.
One shared purpose.

Investigations create the story. Specialist teams bring different perspectives to it. These department introductions outline how each area can contribute to the unit's fictional operations.

AIR SUPPORT

Tactical Pilots

Aviation adds another dimension to an operation, from moving characters between locations to coordinating support for a field team. Planning and communication keep pilots connected to the same story as the agents on the ground.

Department lead: Impaled / GOI-22
DEPARTMENT COORDINATION

TOD

TOD has its own leadership point of contact for members and department activity. Speak with its director about the department's current purpose, available roles, and how it fits into server operations.

Trial director: Jacksaan / GOI-23
FIELD RESPONSE

Mobile Occult Operations Team

Field-based roleplay centred on unusual and occult incidents. Team members can connect discoveries at a scene with an ongoing case, share observations, and build the next stage of an investigation together.

Team lead: SiloMaro
RESOURCES & RECORDS

Financial

Behind each fictional operation is a need for organisation. Financial roleplay can add depth through in-character budgets, resource requests, and records that make the unit feel like a working institution.

Department lead: Shaxx / GOI-25

04 / THE ROLEPLAY EXPERIENCE

Every case has
more than one chapter.

A simple example of how a fictional investigation can unfold. Actual events and procedures are organised through the Discord server.

01 / THE REPORT

Something doesn't add up.

A strange account, an unexplained discovery, or an unusual incident gives the team a starting point.

02 / THE INVESTIGATION

Build a clearer picture.

Characters gather information, compare observations, and work together to decide what the evidence means.

03 / THE RESPONSE

Bring the team together.

Relevant departments contribute to the scene, with room for cooperation, uncertainty, and character decisions.

04 / THE DEBRIEF

Leave a record.

A case summary captures what happened, what was learned, and which questions might lead to the next story.

05 / COMMUNITY CULTURE

Good stories start
with good teammates.

A few principles to bring into every scene. The Discord server's rules remain the place to check formal expectations.

RESPECT

Give everyone room.

Let other members contribute, keep disagreements respectful, and remember that the person behind a character matters more than winning a scene.

COMMUNICATION

Keep the team informed.

Share the information others need, ask when something is unclear, and separate in-character tension from out-of-character conversations.

COLLABORATION

Create something together.

Build on other players' ideas and leave space for unexpected outcomes. A memorable investigation gives everyone a part to play.

NEED HELP?

Start with the right point of contact.

For a department question, look for its listed lead. For general joining information or a concern, use the support route shown in Discord. Follow the server's reporting process for sensitive matters.

Wyoming case file

Issued by
J. Edgar Hoover Building Washington

Logibear, Deputy Director of the Unusual Incidents Unit
File date
September 7, 2026
Operation
Blind Eye

Fictional roleplay case. Contains descriptions of death and missing children.

Section 1: The Start of the Events.

On December 19th 2025 our agents intercepted a 911 call. The person seemed Distressed and alert, on the call we got the persons name [REDACTED], based on the call we could tell he was in contact with a anomaly so the call was tracked. The call traced to a national park "Yellowstone National Park WY" we were getting reports of stuff people couldn't explain from there but we didn't take action until now. The call came to a end with him hanging up we sent two units a tactical team to the caller and agents to wipe the call records and take the 911 dispatcher.

Section 2: Alpha Team Arrival.

About 5 minutes after the call hanged up alpha team arrived. After review of helmet cams this is what happened. Alpha team stepped out of there vehicles following the trail, doing so they located a cell phone which was taken in and to be from the caller they marked and headed more up the trail about 3 minutes since arrival they located a body. [WARNING This may be Graphic For some People] The body which was the caller was dead on scene the head was exploded which parts of the brain, Skull And skin were everywhere but no blood was located.

Section 3: Caller 2

After what happened nothing else popped up until May 23rd 2026 Our agents intercepted another 911 call this time it was a women and she experienced the same thing as caller 1. Bravo team arrived to unfortunately find her dead everything that happened to caller one happened to her but this time it was more down the trail. Bravo team while there located a anomaly above her the anomaly ran to a abandoned village it entered a building which is "Building 3" As Bravo Team got close we alerted them to not to enter and to secure the perimeter they did and our agents arrived.

Section 4: Perimeter Actions.

After this we told the public that a chemical spill happened and to not come in a certain range we set up a tactical operations center in one of our trailers at the point near by on the other side we have set up a tent which contains equipment and computers. With all of this we have alerted the foundation and they said we are taking lead with this and request resources if needed. We are setting up 24/7 Security and more action will be taken Operation Blind Eye which is to head in and secure the area is taking effect in the next week or so.

Section 5: Missing Children.

So we have made a new discovery in the town nearby there has been over 50 missing kids but one of the perimeter security saw a child being dragged by a anomaly the team rushed over but the anomaly disappeared with the child the team explained what they saw. [REDACTED] After this we have reason to believe those 50 kids have been taken into this village. After this discovery we alerted the foundation quite fast they agreed with us that we are going to have to act fast but with this came a new discovery we don't know how to explain it but we are quite sure what it is. With every kid the anomaly gets the village just expands like a new building or a well or something along those lines with this we have pushed the outpost back, security still monitors along the village but the outposts have been moved back. Operation Blind Eye Is took take affect in the up coming days these kids need saving and we are there only hope at survival sadly after this the foundation is going to take them erase there minds and put them in a basement of a house and call the police.

UIU FILE #3MissouriOPEN / CLOSE FILE
UNUSUAL INCIDENTS UNITCLASSIFIED / ROLEPLAY
Issued by
M. Deer Field Office Building Missouri
Approved by
Logibear, Deputy Director of the UIU
File date
October 5, 2026 / UIU File #3
Incident date
October 16, 2025

Fictional roleplay file. The locations and events described in this report are not real.

Section 1: The start of the events

On October 16, 2025, we intercepted a 911 call coming from Green State Campus.

The caller was later identified as a student on campus. As the call continued, the caller seemed very distressed. Then the call went silent, and all we could hear was breathing and people screaming.

The dispatcher kept calling his name, but he did not respond. Eventually, another person picked up the phone and stated that they had taken the campus. The call then cut out.

We later reviewed the CCTV footage and identified two faces. These individuals were already known to us because of previous events involving the summoning of anomalies and other incidents documented in another file. Their profiles are recorded below.

Individuals identified in the report

FICTIONAL CHARACTER / 01

Dave Harbor

Age: 27

According to the report, he believes he is an anomaly, that he owns everything, and that the planet will fall.

FICTIONAL CHARACTER / 02

Emma Jones

Age: 29

According to the report, she intends to destroy the planet.

Section 2: Delta Team Arrival

About six hours after the incident was discovered, Delta Team of TOD was sent to investigate. Once the team arrived, it became clear that they were severely underprepared.

Unidentified vines covered the interior, and there was no light, even with helmet lights switched on. The phenomenon appeared to feed on the light, consuming it rather than simply blocking it at a certain distance.

Delta Team discovered the bodies of students. When a team member approached, an anomaly grabbed him. The missing member was Delta Team's medic.

There was no sign of Target A or Target B, Dave Harbor and Emma Jones. The team was ordered to withdraw. Following their departure, the location was placed under 24/7 security and the Foundation was alerted.

Section 3: Security Measures Taken

Standard security measures were established, including 24/7 security and a tactical operations center (TOC). The SCP Foundation was notified. The report warns that further delays increase the likelihood of the phenomenon spreading.

Night-vision cameras continue to be placed inside the location, but they are repeatedly destroyed, limiting monitoring.

Section 4: Operation Intercept

Operation Intercept is described as an imminent response to a potential threat to Missouri. Its stated objective is to locate and neutralize Dave Harbor and Emma Jones. The report says a similar incident has happened twice and that the two targets escaped after their earlier capture; it rules out taking them alive again.

TOD will lead the operation, with M.O.O.T on standby. The report anticipates possible fatalities.

MOP will transport TOD into the zone and extract them afterward, and will bring M.O.O.T in if required.

06 / BEFORE YOU JOIN

A little more intel.

Quick answers for new members exploring the community.

What is this community about?

This is a fictional FBI UIU roleplay community built around unusual incidents, investigations, and teamwork. The website introduces the setting and the people leading it.

How do I join?

Use the Join Discord button below, read the server information, and follow the joining instructions there. Check the operations board for proposed activities and Discord for confirmed sessions.

Do I need previous roleplay experience?

We operate in ERLC and BRM5. Check the current game and entry requirements in Discord. If you are new to this style of roleplay, ask the team what guidance is available before choosing a role.

Can I join a specialist department?

Ask the relevant department lead about current openings and any requirements. Being listed on this website does not mean a department is currently recruiting.

Where can I find events, rules, and announcements?

Discord is the place to check the community's latest announcements, rules, and scheduled activities. Refer to those updates for current information.

Is this connected to the real FBI?

No. This is a fictional roleplay community and is not affiliated with the FBI or any government agency. Its cases, operations, and financial activities are part of roleplay.
